label: lem:antideriv_diff_zero_deriv
title: Difference of antiderivatives has zero derivative
statement: If $F$ and $G$ are both antiderivatives of $f$ on $(a,b)$, then $(F - G)'(x) = f(x) - f(x) = 0$ for all $x \in (a,b)$.
proof: Immediate from linearity of the derivative (\texttt{HasDerivAt.sub}).
